report_name: ServiceNow Patches Three Critical CVSS 10.0 Flaws in AI Platform

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-18885
vulnerabilities.description: A code injection vulnerability in the GraphQL Composite Data API that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the instance by sending a specially crafted request.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-18886
vulnerabilities.description: An improper access control vulnerability in the system configuration image upload processor, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to upload malicious files, leading to full privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-74820
vulnerabilities.description: A SQL injection vulnerability within a dynamic schema ORDER BY clause, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary SQL commands to read, modify, or delete data.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-6876
vulnerabilities.description: A sandbox escape vulnerability in the Now Platform that could permit arbitrary code execution.

identities.name: Fortune 500 companies
identities.description: A class of potential victims, as 85% of Fortune 500 companies use the vulnerable ServiceNow platforms.

indicators.name: Anomalous ServiceNow GraphQL API Request
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous ServiceNow GraphQL API Request
id: 9b1d8e4c-5b7a-4f3e-8c1d-9a8b7c6d5e4f
status: experimental
description: Monitors for requests to the ServiceNow GraphQL API endpoint, which could indicate attempts to exploit CVE-2026-18885.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/three-cvss-100-servicenow-flaws-could.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-28
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: medium
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    c-uri|contains: '/api/now/graphql'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects web requests to the ServiceNow GraphQL API endpoint, which could be targeted for exploitation of CVE-2026-18885.

indicators.name: Suspicious ServiceNow File Upload
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious ServiceNow File Upload
id: a2b3c4d5-e6f7-4a9b-8cde-f1234567890a
status: experimental
description: Monitors for file uploads to a ServiceNow endpoint that could be leveraged to exploit CVE-2026-18886.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/three-cvss-100-servicenow-flaws-could.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-28
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: medium
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    c-uri|contains: '/sys_attachment.do'
    cs-method: 'POST'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects POST requests to the /sys_attachment.do endpoint, which could indicate attempts to exploit the improper access control vulnerability CVE-2026-18886.

indicators.name: Suspicious Child Process from ServiceNow Platform
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Child Process from ServiceNow Platform
id: b3c4d5e6-f7a8-4b0c-9def-0123456789ab
status: experimental
description: Detects suspicious child processes spawned by ServiceNow's core Java or Node.js processes, indicating potential remote code execution.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/three-cvss-100-servicenow-flaws-could.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-28
tags:
  - attack.t1059
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\java.exe'
      - '\node.exe'
      - '/java'
      - '/node'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\sh.exe'
      - '\bash.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
      - '/curl'
      - '/wget'
  condition: all of selection_*
indicators.description: Detects when ServiceNow's core processes (Java, Node.js) spawn shells or network utilities, which is a strong indicator of successful code execution from a vulnerability exploit.
